capacity_arbitration_interaction: Selection remains upstream and cannot be bypassed.
cash_identity: ordinary/recycled are overlapping classifications of authoritative portfolio.cash; they are never summed as separate economic balances.
cash_path: Portfolio.close_position computes sell fill and proceeds
positive pnl tax is reserved using authoritative configured rate
realized_pnl separately increases by gross pnl
strict close_trade reconciles authoritative net realized tax reserve and records ClosedTrade
Candidate qualification continues at CLOSE without Profit Recycling intervention
accepted pending signal executes at next legitimate symbol OPEN
classification_only_role: Profit Recycling V1 can attach configuration-provenant lots to already-existing after-tax realized-profit cash and attribute later qualified-trade cash consumption. It cannot unlock cash because no lock exists, add cash, change sizing, or alter economics.
dynamic_sizing_interaction: Dynamic Sizing remains authoritative downstream; classification cannot increase its requested/final shares.
economic_redundancy_finding: An enabled cash-release/transfer feature would duplicate current economics and risk fabricating cash. No such integration was implemented.
main_finding: Profitable close proceeds net of authoritative tax are already immediately reusable by the next qualified swing entry; no Thursday gating exists.
no_double_counting_proof: recycled_profit_balance must be <= authoritative ordinary_unrestricted_swing_cash; consume checks both classified balance and authoritative cash and never mutates Portfolio.cash or equity.
pyramiding_interaction: Pyramiding retains its own cash/risk/cap checks; classification cannot bypass them.
qdte_interaction: QDTE distributions and income-rebalance pnl remain separate ineligible sources; V1 destination permits SWING_REDEPLOYMENT_POOL only.
regime_allocation_interaction: Regime Allocation remains independent and unchanged.
tax_interaction: Only ClosedTrade.pnl-tax_reserved is an eligible candidate; tax_reserve_cash is never eligible or consumed.
